name: webmcp-extension
description: Chrome extension and companion server for inspecting, monitoring, and executing WebMCP tools exposed by web pages.

scripts.check:syntax: for f in server/*.js scripts/*.js extension/*.js; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done
scripts.test: rm -rf dist/tests && esbuild tests/*.test.ts tests/smoke/*.smoke.test.ts --bundle --platform=node --packages=external --format=esm --jsx=automatic --outdir=dist/tests && node --test dist/tests/*.test.js dist/tests/smoke/*.smoke.test.js; status=$?; rm -rf dist/tests; exit $status
scripts.test:smoke: rm -rf dist/tests && esbuild tests/smoke/*.smoke.test.ts --bundle --platform=node --packages=external --format=esm --jsx=automatic --outdir=dist/tests/smoke && node --test dist/tests/smoke/*.smoke.test.js; status=$?; rm -rf dist/tests; exit $status
